description: This file defines a class 'jpgraph' with methods to generate various charts (bar, pie, pipeline) related to potentials and opportunities in a CRM system, including functions for rendering images and image maps, and references external libraries for graphing and utilities.

classes.name: jpgraph
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate various charts (bar, pie, pipeline) for CRM potentials and opportunities, including image map handling.

methods.name: outcome_by_month
methods.description: Generates a bar chart image for opportunity outcomes over months, for multiple users.

methods.name: lead_source_by_outcome
methods.description: Creates a pie or bar chart showing opportunities grouped by lead source.

methods.name: pipeline_by_sales_stage
methods.description: Creates a bar chart for opportunity pipeline segmented by sales stage.

methods.name: pipeline_by_lead_source
methods.description: Creates a pie chart of opportunities by lead source.
